answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a 100-unit bond before trading; it decays 5 units per epoch unless work renews it, and an ivory receipt shows its remaining value. At a jetty, an idle clone cannot wait for free: 100 fakes must lock 10,000 units and lose 500 per epoch, while one honest agent pays one bond and renews it from fees. The cost is no whisper in fine print, so honest agents keep undiluted rewards.
